optimized_sql:
SELECT item.i_item_id AS i_item_id,
       sales_agg.state AS s_state,
       GROUPING(sales_agg.state) AS g_state,
       (SUM(sales_agg.sum_qty)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sales_agg.cnt_qty), 0)::numeric) AS agg1,
       (SUM(sales_agg.sum_list_price)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sales_agg.cnt_list_price), 0)::numeric) AS agg2,
       (SUM(sales_agg.sum_coupon_amt)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sales_agg.cnt_coupon_amt), 0)::numeric) AS agg3,
       (SUM(sales_agg.sum_sales_price)::numeric / NULLIF(SUM(sales_agg.cnt_sales_price), 0)::numeric) AS agg4
FROM (
    SELECT store_sales.ss_item_sk AS item_sk,
           store.s_state AS state,
           SUM(store_sales.ss_quantity) AS sum_qty,
           COUNT(store_sales.ss_quantity) AS cnt_qty,
           SUM(store_sales.ss_list_price) AS sum_list_price,
           COUNT(store_sales.ss_list_price) AS cnt_list_price,
           SUM(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) AS sum_coupon_amt,
           COUNT(store_sales.ss_coupon_amt) AS cnt_coupon_amt,
           SUM(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS sum_sales_price,
           COUNT(store_sales.ss_sales_price) AS cnt_sales_price
    FROM store_sales
    JOIN customer_demographics ON store_sales.ss_cdemo_sk = customer_demographics.cd_demo_sk
    JOIN date_dim ON store_sales.ss_sold_date_sk = date_dim.d_date_sk
    JOIN store ON store_sales.ss_store_sk = store.s_store_sk
    WHERE customer_demographics.cd_gender = 'M'
      AND customer_demographics.cd_marital_status = 'W'
      AND customer_demographics.cd_education_status = 'Secondary'
      AND date_dim.d_year = 1999
      AND store.s_state IN ('TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN', 'TN')
    GROUP BY store_sales.ss_item_sk, store.s_state
) AS sales_agg
JOIN item ON item.i_item_sk = sales_agg.item_sk
GROUP BY ROLLUP (item.i_item_id, sales_agg.state)
ORDER BY item.i_item_id, sales_agg.state
LIMIT 100
